create_oracle23ai_client: create an Oracle23aiClient instance that initializes a connection pool and database schema for vector search
insert_vector_items: insert a list of VectorItem objects into an Oracle23aiClient collection with id, text, vector, and metadata
search_similar_vectors: search for similar vectors in an Oracle23aiClient collection using cosine distance and return matching results
delete_items_by_id: delete specific items from an Oracle23aiClient collection by providing a list of item IDs
delete_collection: delete an entire collection from an Oracle23aiClient by removing all items matching the collection name
